the combination of accelerometer and gyroscope is the best performing feature set for activity recognition in a smartphone.

1) sensor fusion improves the recognition accuracy by 10%, 2) the magnetometer sensor does not provide significant information for activity recognition, 3) the accelerometer and gyroscope sensors provide the best results when used together and 4) the most discriminative feature is the standard deviation of the gyroscope data.

a lightweight classifier can be used to achieve good recognition performance with a low computational cost.
